name: bookings
description: Lets your clients book time slots at your clinic, salon or tuition, and shows today's bookings first; one client per slot (not group classes with a capacity); not for noting your own appointments.

minutes.note: copied from the service when booked, so editing a service does not move old bookings

settings.label: Opening hours by weekday, "0" (Sunday) to "6" (Saturday): ["HH:MM", "HH:MM"] for open and close, or null when closed
settings.constraint: hours must be an object with a key for each weekday "0" (Sunday) to "6" (Saturday), each ["HH:MM", "HH:MM"] or null when closed

settings.label: Minutes between the start times offered (5 to 240)
settings.constraint: slot_minutes must be a whole number from 5 to 240
